summary: Rithm Perpetual Life Residential Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing its net asset value per share for each share class as of July 31, 2026. The filing provides NAV per share for Class J common shares at $20.1595 and Class E common shares at $20.2982, based on total NAV of $151.9 million across 7,534,080 outstanding shares. This is a routine periodic disclosure of portfolio valuation metrics for a nontraded REIT, not a corporate event. There are no deal terms, acquisitions, or strategic actions; the filing is purely informational. No special-situation catalyst or transaction is indicated.
